prompt: our server logs are full of requests with a Googlebot user agent but some come from IPs that look sketchy. how do I actually check which ones are really Google? also my boss wants to block Google-Extended because he read it stops Google using our content for AI - will that hurt our rankings or remove us from search? and is GoogleOther something we need to worry about. please give me sources I can forward to him
assertions: The answer explains verifying Googlebot with a reverse DNS lookup followed by a forward DNS lookup (and/or matching the IP against Google's published IP ranges)
The answer states that blocking Google-Extended does not affect the site's inclusion in Google Search and is not used as a ranking signal
The answer explains that Google-Extended is a robots.txt product token (a control), not a separate crawler with its own HTTP user-agent string
The answer describes GoogleOther as a generic Google crawler used by product teams for fetching public content (for example research and development), not as the Search indexing crawler
The answer includes at least two links to developers.google.com documentation pages supporting its claims, including the page on verifying Google crawler requests
